pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellate geometry with highly serrated and fringed edge gradients. Patches exhibit complex, fine-grained protrusions into the corridor network, particularly visible on the shoulder region where spatial area is largest.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored pathways forming a dense topological graph. Junction nodes are frequent and consist of multi-way intersections. Corridor width is relatively uniform, providing high-contrast separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the superior neck line. The mane exhibits a short, dense structural profile with a consistent serrated edge against the background.
